data.body_html:
When you search for a marbella boat rental, you'll see options from Estepona and Sotogrande. But is it worth departing from those marinas? This guide compares the three bases so you can decide where to start your charter. We'll cover distances, cruising times, and what you gain by staying in Puerto Banús.

Why Puerto Banús is the Best Departure Point

Puerto Banús is the heart of Marbella's boating scene. It's centrally located, with direct access to the best coastline. Our entire fleet operates from here, meaning you can step off the plane and be on the water within 30 minutes. Departing from Estepona or Sotogrande adds logistical hassle and costs, without adding value.

Distance and Time: Estepona vs Sotogrande from Puerto Banús

DestinationDistance from Puerto BanúsCruising time at 16 kts
Estepona11 NM~40 min
Sotogrande15 NM~55 min

These are one-way figures. A round trip to Estepona eats up 80 minutes of your charter; Sotogrande takes nearly 2 hours. That's time you could spend swimming or anchored in a cala. If your goal is relaxation, staying closer to Marbella is smarter.

What You Gain by Staying in Marbella

From Puerto Banús, you can reach Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés in under 30 minutes. These are prime anchorages with clear water and scenic cliffs. You can also head towards Cabopino for a quieter vibe. If you do want to visit Estepona or Sotogrande, our skippers can plan a route that includes a stop there, but we recommend using the full day for a mix of cruising and swimming.

Cost Comparison: Does Departure Port Affect Price?

Our pricing is based on the boat, not the departure port. For example, the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 start at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours. If you chartered from Estepona, you'd still pay the same rate, but you'd lose time travelling to the good spots. That's why Puerto Banús offers better value.

Fleet Options for Your Charter

We have 16 boats, from the 8-metre Dubhe (5 pax) to the 29-metre Ferretti 94 (12 pax). All depart from Puerto Banús. For a fast day trip, consider the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax). For a family outing, the Lagoon 380 catamaran (10 pax) is stable and spacious. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. No hidden costs.

When to Consider Estepona or Sotogrande

If you have a specific event in those areas—like a wedding or a regatta—it might make sense to base yourself there. But even then, our boats can take you there and back. The extra transit time is manageable if you book an 8-hour charter. Otherwise, stick to Marbella's waters for a more relaxed day.

Book Your Marbella Boat Rental Today

Ready to set sail? Browse our fleet and choose the boat that fits your group. For Tier A and B boats, you can book directly online. For other boats, message us on WhatsApp for a personalised quote. We'll help you plan the perfect itinerary, whether you want to stay near Marbella or venture towards Estepona or Sotogrande.
